Card Q&A.a: Yes, blocking causes the attack target to switch, so the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon attacks my opponent, then my opponent blocks. Does this card's [All Turns] effect activate?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect activate even when the attack whose target is switched was made by one of my other Digimon or an opponent's Digimon?

Effect: ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an attack target is switched, you may play 1 black or red Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, it gains ＜Piercing＞.
